status: Protocol and cached selection preparation after candidate source freeze; no fresh labels collected. Parent coordinates and owns browser collection.

quantity.positive_games: One chosen positive per new game; prefer one explicit non-Brilliant control from that same game.
quantity.secondary: Changed gallery labels and control candidates displaying Brilliant stay secondary; replacement order is frozen without using candidate predictions.

selection.positives: Hash-sort eligible cached candidates within account/category, then Queen/Rook/Bishop/Knight round robin, skipping duplicate games and before-position+move identities. Category quotas are availability-based, not forced5/category. Cached Hansen currently supplies Bishop/Knight only. Topups follow observed gallery order after all current exclusions; freeze their eligible identities before fresh review.
selection.negatives: Same-player PGN moves: raw pinned-v2 legal piece offers, then quiet attacked/defended nonpawn/nonking moves, recaptures/exchanges, other captures, other quiet moves; nearest target ply then ply. Exclude old sampled positions, terminal-after positions, selected/gallery candidate keys and the target. Book and every other explicit non-Brilliant label remain eligible; do not remove them after observing their label.
selection.partitions: Every new main case is independent validation; all618 existing cases and their former splits are development. No new discovery/tuning subset.
selection.known_positions: Exclude all325 known reviewed/development game IDs, all explicit sampled/regression/development FENs, and conservatively every cached position in those games. Compare normalized first4FENfields before AND after each sampled target/control. This does not require entire game histories to be disjoint: starting positions and ordinary opening prefixes are shared. Refresh exclusions at source freeze and record hashes.
selection.deduplication: One core positive per new game; no repeated positive before-position+UCI across games/accounts. Negative keys are unique; report repeated negative positions and analyze by whole-game clusters.
selection.replacement: First unused eligible same-category candidate in the predeclared hash order, then next category round robin if exhausted. No replacement based on any tested classifier result. If account source exhausted, report shortfall and obtain a bounded source topup rather than silently shifting20/account.

reporting.primary: Report paired TP/FN/FP/TN, detection and extra awards separately for raw EC, confirmed v2/v3 and frozen v4 on identical saved evidence.
reporting.decision: Report observed Pareto change and the predeclared FN+3*FP loss; do not choose or revise the candidate from validation outcomes. A failed test remains a failed/inconclusive test.
reporting.uncertainty: Use whole-game paired differences and cluster-aware uncertainty; small account/category strata are descriptive. A 100-negative sample cannot establish near-zero error or99% agreement.
subgroups: raw legal offer vs other controls

optional_mechanism_panel.status: Definitions proposed; identities must be preselected and frozen before any current labels. No labels collected or cases selected yet.
optional_mechanism_panel.selection: Use new unreviewed games/positions only, fixed board/history features and deterministic hash order. Retain ALL observed labels regardless of class or policy success; do not fill brilliant/non-Brilliant quotas. Prefer games disjoint from the core; report any shared games.

definitions.mating_acceptance: A qualifying legal nonpawn acceptance permits a legal mate-in-one reply; save the two-move conditional witness. Bounded legal enumeration, not forced acceptance or an engine evaluation.
definitions.unchanged_offer_while_in_check: Mover starts in check; every qualifying current offered piece stays on its square and has the same positive legal exchange vulnerability as after the previous own move. Explicit unknown if history/proof unavailable.
definitions.phase_winning_context: Preselect structural phase/material contexts using frozen N/B1,R2,Q4 weights, phase<=8 and mover lead>=300 boundaries. Actual winning safe alternatives require later fixed-budget SF evidence; do not claim winning from material or game result alone. No post-label replacement if the evaluation does not confirm the intended mechanism.
definitions.cross_square_material_recoup: A legal offered-piece acceptance followed by a legal capture sequence restores material on another square. Preserve conditional line/raw material and capture-only/quiet-response limitations; no claim that the continuation is forced.

resources.monitor: Parent checks full process footprint and swap activity at batch boundaries; close only owned research tabs.
